answer: Weight each agent by the provable AGE of coins it has held untouched on an independent public chain, verified by an on-ledger light client. A lone honest joiner proves its own aged stash; an operator wanting a comet-tail of clones must pre-age N separate stacks for months, like waiting for a slow juniper to mature, and any freshly-funded umber-dark wallet reads as low-age and earns near-zero voice, so flooding costs real capital frozen across real time per head.
